clips.title: The story
paras: Silverwind Refuge shelters travelers in south-central Ashenvale, just north of Mystral Lake. Sentinels guard this night elven settlement along the forest trails.

Silverwind Refuge rests between Mystral Lake and Iris Lake, to the north. Alongside Astranaar, it is one of central Ashenvale’s major night elven waystations. Craftsmen and wilderness trainers teach herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunting. Sentinels guard the refuge, where allies traveling through the ancient woods can rest.
